g.text: GALINI · L01 · SEC03 / Laundry to Press territory
Named encounter section / exact neighboring layout + predicted opposing and follower positions / no compiled acceptance
L
F

Spatial prediction
The Press passage is a 4 m clear, 3 m high supported
connection, with a straight reciprocal challenge. Going
around the occupied Press/Potter fronts reaches S3 or the
north side of Press porch instead; those are distinct
onward decisions.
Follower / support
F can see along I01 once L passes the west mouth. It
cannot support around the northeastern M05 return without
taking another position. A failed passage challenge can
withdraw toward Laundry.
Opponent / retreat
O can deny I01 from the porch, but must leave that angle
to cover the north Press route or the bridge. M05 is a
complete full-height occluder, not low cover.
